subject: design/local-work-tracker-v2
statement: one work item is one file, `<work_items_root>/items/<id>.md`, with three regions: a **closed-schema front-matter header** of typed fields, a free-markdown **body** (the description), and an append-only **log** of timestamped entries (comments, decision-records, transition audit). One file per item is what makes an item independently readable, hand-editable, git-diffable, and mergeable (G3/J4), and atomically replaceable (§3.4).
